headline: Seattle Pacific now have the most wins in the division
dek: Seattle Pacific beat Western Oregon and moved clear of Cal State LA and Charleston, the two programmes they had been level with on wins. No other side in the division has now won as many matches.
displaced_by: results night: Seattle Pacific's win over Western Oregon took them clear of Cal State LA and Charleston as the division's outright leaders on wins
